about.heading: About
body: I'm a frontend developer who values the balance between user experience and code quality. Working mainly with React and TypeScript, I love crafting interfaces that get the small details right.
I enjoy turning complex problems into simple solutions, collaborating closely with design and product to ship polished work. I pick up new tools quickly, but I apply them in proven, dependable ways.
